description: The substrate hands the loop an issue and its pull request as two API objects; §3 says they are one unit of intended change. i1 is the intent record, at in_flight because a change exists, carrying only the ref; p1 is the record holding the change. One unit gets one verdict, and it belongs to the record holding the change — i1 defers instead of inventing a second opinion about the same work. WIP is charged once, not twice: with a ceiling of 1 and one unit in flight, i2 is held.
